Players Committee card image of [[Darth Vader, Emperor's Enforcer]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. You may initiate battles here for free. Once per turn, may cancel game text of opponent's character of ability < 4 at same site until end of turn. Immune to Clash of Sabers, Sorry About The Mess, and attrition < 6.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderemperorsenforcer.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
